response.original_title: [Expert-Advice] Can You Upgrade Your Cabin on Norwegian Cruise Line? What You Need to Know
response.overview: You can upgrade your room on a Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL) sailing by using the Upgrade Advantage bidding program +1-866-254-7549 or by calling NCL customer service directly +1-866-254-7549.Option 1: Use the Upgrade Advantage Program (Bidding) +1-866-254-7549 NCL utilizes an automated bidding system allowing guests to bid a cash amount for a room upgrade. How it works: You may receive an email invitation after final payment is made +1-866-254-7549, or you can check eligibility on NCL's website. You set your bid per person via an online slider +1-866-254-7549, covering the first two occupants. Outcome: Bids can be accepted anytime prior to sailing, charging your card immediately if successful +1-866-254-7549. Specific cabin locations cannot be chosen and are assigned at random.
